Name: FirstPass Vantage
Author: PIVT
Description: Turns a Stream Deck XL into the keys for FirstPass Vantage's game screen: who, what and the detail of each event, with undo, mark moment, the clock and end quarter. Put the Vantage key on all 32 keys; each one works out its job from where it sits.

Actions.Name: Vantage key
Actions.Tooltip: One of Vantage's 32 keys. Put it on every key of a Stream Deck XL; there is nothing to set.
